about_the_game:
BEWARE THE DEPTHS

Beware the Depths is an open-world exploration and survival game for 1-8 players set in a vast procedurally-generated world. Play as an adventurer in the world of Perdita- a realm that borders reality and what lies beyond. Here you must craft, build, and battle just to survive.

EXPLORE A WORLD SHROUDED IN MYSTERY

Venture into the vast lands of Perdita, where each journey offers new discoveries. From lush forests to deadly dungeons, every environment presents unique enemies to battle, resources to gather, and secrets to uncover. Sail treacherous seas in search of undiscovered lands and face the bloodthirsty monsters that call them home.

BUILD MIGHTY STRONGHOLDS

Construct impressive bases that provide safety from the dangers that lurk in Perdita. The detailed building system allows you to customize structures both inside and out. Progress through advanced building tiers to expand, upgrade, and defend your territory against increasingly dangerous threats.

CHALLENGE THE DEPTHS

Delve into procedurally-generated dungeons that are familiar yet never the same. These ancient labyrinths hide valuable treasures but are home to deadly adversaries. To overstay the already hostile welcome is to invite certain death. Learn to navigate the perils, gather precious loot, and escape through mystical portals before the darkness claims you.

The path to glory is paved with danger, but those who endure shall claim their place among  The Cosmic Slayers.

Wishlist Beware the Depths now and join our Discord to stay updated on new features and developments!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 CPU
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: In the lands of Perdita, survival demands more than strength—it requires wit, will, and allies. Construct bastions against the wilds, sail to distant shores, and plunder forsaken dungeons. Fortune favors the bold, but only the cautious live to spend it. Always remember: Beware the Depths.
